description: The film chronicles the inspiring true story of the Indian national cricket team's journey to win the 1983 Cricket World Cup. Led by their captain Kapil Dev, the underdog team faces immense challenges and skepticism as they aim to achieve an unprecedented victory on the global stage.

title: A Family Affair
description: A young woman's life is thrown into chaos when she discovers her widowed mother is secretly dating her demanding movie star boss. This unexpected romance leads to humorous and complicated situations as the trio navigates their intertwined personal and professional lives.

title: ABCD 2
description: ABCD 2 follows a group of passionate young dancers from Nalasopara, India, who dream of making it big on the international stage. Faced with a tarnished reputation and numerous obstacles, they embark on a journey to prove their worth and represent their country at a prestigious hip-hop competition in Las Vegas, guided by their determined mentor.

title: Ace Ventura: Pet Detective
description: Ace Ventura is a flamboyant and eccentric private investigator specializing in the retrieval of stolen or missing animals. He is hired to find Snowflake, the abducted bottlenose dolphin mascot for the Miami Dolphins football team, just weeks before the Super Bowl. His unconventional methods and unique personality lead him through a bizarre investigation full of strange characters and hilarious mishaps.

title: Adolescence: Limited Series
description: This limited series delves into the multifaceted journey of adolescence, exploring the pivotal moments and emotional growth of young characters. It navigates themes of self-discovery, evolving relationships, and the unique pressures faced while transitioning into adulthood.

title: Ae Dil Hai Mushkil
description: This film explores the complexities of unrequited love and friendship, focusing on a young man's journey through various relationships. It delves into the pain and joy of loving someone who doesn't reciprocate the same feelings, set against a backdrop of modern relationships and emotional conflicts.

title: Ala Vaikunthapurramuloo
description: A young man, switched at birth, grows up in a middle-class family while his biological parents raise another child in immense wealth. Unaware of his true lineage, he finds himself drawn to the lavish Vaikunthapurram, eventually uncovering the truth about his origins. He then decides to enter the opulent household, not to reclaim his rightful place, but to protect his biological family and bring joy to his birth mother.

title: Alice in Borderland: Season 1
description: Three aimless friends suddenly find themselves in a mysteriously deserted Tokyo, where they are forced to participate in a series of deadly games. These games test their physical and mental limits, and successful completion grants them 'visas' to continue living. They must navigate this dangerous new world, constantly playing to survive and uncover the truth behind their predicament.

title: Alice in Borderland: Season 2
description: Arisu and Usagi, having survived the initial deadly games, must now face even more challenging and brutal "face card" games in their quest to return to their original world. As they fight for survival and seek answers, they encounter new allies and enemies, all while the mysteries of the Borderland deepen.

title: Alice in Borderland: Season 3
description: The highly anticipated third season of the popular Japanese series is expected to continue the intense and deadly survival games. Players trapped in a desolate, parallel Tokyo must once again face intricate challenges and psychological warfare to escape their perilous reality and uncover its ultimate truth.

title: All of Us Are Dead: Season 1
description: When a science experiment goes wrong, a high school becomes ground zero for a zombie virus outbreak. Trapped inside, a group of students must band together to fight for their lives against their infected classmates. They face impossible odds as they try to survive the onslaught and find a way to escape the school.

title: Amar Singh Chamkila
description: This biographical musical drama chronicles the short but impactful life of Amar Singh Chamkila, a popular and controversial Punjabi singer from the 1980s. Rising from poverty to become a superstar with his outspoken lyrics, he and his wife Amarjot faced both immense adoration and severe criticism. The film explores their journey, their music, and the tragic circumstances surrounding their untimely demise.

title: Amaran
description: The film tells the inspiring true story of Major Mukund Varadarajan, a decorated Indian Army officer. It chronicles his courageous journey and the significant sacrifices he made during counter-insurgency operations, showcasing his unwavering dedication to duty and country.

title: Animal
description: A wealthy businessman's son, deeply devoted to his father but constantly seeking his approval, takes a violent and vengeful path after an assassination attempt on his father. He wages a brutal war against his family's adversaries, driven by a desire to protect his loved ones and prove his loyalty. The film explores themes of family loyalty, toxic masculinity, and the blurred lines between love and obsession.

title: Annaatthe (Hindi)
description: The film centers on a loving elder brother who dotes on his younger sister and vows to protect her at all costs. After her marriage, he discovers she is facing significant difficulties and threats in her new life. He then embarks on a mission to safeguard her and uphold his family's honor, confronting formidable adversaries along the way.

title: Bade Miyan Chote Miyan
description: Two Indian army officers with contrasting personalities are brought together for a high-stakes mission. They must recover a stolen weapon that threatens the country's security and confront a notorious arms dealer. Despite their differences, they form an unlikely duo to protect the nation from a dangerous threat.

title: Badhaai Do
description: A gay man and a lesbian woman decide to enter a marriage of convenience to appease their traditional Indian families. While living together as a married couple, they navigate the complexities of their arrangement, their personal lives, and the societal pressures that come with their unconventional secret. This leads to a series of comedic and poignant moments as they strive for acceptance and understanding.

title: Badrinath Ki Dulhania
description: Badrinath Bansal, a simple man from Jhansi, falls deeply in love with Vaidehi Trivedi, an ambitious and independent woman from Kota. Vaidehi dreams of a career and a life beyond traditional expectations, which clashes with Badrinath's desire for marriage. Their differing views lead them on a journey of self-discovery, challenging societal norms and their own perceptions of love and equality.

title: Bagheera
description: A man with a mysterious past and multiple identities embarks on a dark mission, targeting women he believes are deserving of his hunt. The film delves into his complex psychological motives as he navigates a world filled with suspense and intense encounters.

title: Bandidos: Season 1
description: A charming con man and his crew embark on a high-stakes adventure in the Mexican Caribbean to find a legendary Mayan treasure. They must outsmart ruthless criminals and overcome various traps and challenges to claim the ancient riches before their rivals.

title: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice
description: Fearing the unchecked power of a god-like superhero, Gotham City's formidable vigilante, Batman, takes on Metropolis's revered savior, Superman. As the world grapples with what kind of hero it truly needs, the two iconic figures clash, setting the stage for a conflict that will determine the fate of humanity. Their struggle is further complicated by the rise of a new threat that endangers both heroes and the planet.

title: Bheeshma
description: Bheeshma, a perpetually single young man, yearns for love and falls for a woman named Chaitra. His attempts to win her over lead him into a series of comedic events and an unexpected entanglement with a corporate rivalry concerning organic farming. He finds himself caught between his personal quest for a partner and the future of a prominent company.

title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa
description: An NRI couple returns to their ancestral palace in India, only to find themselves embroiled in a series of unexplained and eerie occurrences. The family believes the mansion is haunted by a vengeful spirit from its past, leading to a mix of fear and superstition. A psychiatrist is called upon to delve into the mysterious events and distinguish between a supernatural haunting and psychological phenomena.

title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa 2
description: A fraud psychic, Ruhan, accidentally reopens a long-sealed room in a haunted mansion, inadvertently unleashing a vengeful spirit. He must then pretend to be a ghostbuster to protect the family from the supernatural occurrences, leading to a chaotic mix of scares and laughter as he tries to solve the mystery.

title: Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3
description: Bhool Bhulaiyaa 3 is the highly anticipated third installment in the popular horror-comedy franchise, with Kartik Aaryan returning as Rooh Baba. The film is expected to delve deeper into supernatural mysteries and comedic escapades, continuing the series' unique blend of scares and laughter. It will likely feature a new haunted scenario where Rooh Baba is called upon to confront and resolve paranormal disturbances.

title: Black Adam
description: Nearly 5,000 years after he was bestowed with the almighty powers of the ancient gods and imprisoned, Black Adam is freed from his earthly tomb. He unleashes his unique form of justice on the modern world, quickly catching the attention of the Justice Society of America. They arrive to stop his rampage and teach him what it means to be a hero, but Black Adam refuses to bow to anyone.

title: Blackhat
description: A furloughed convicted hacker is tasked with tracking down a high-level cybercrime network responsible for a global incident. He teams up with American and Chinese partners, racing against time across multiple continents to identify and neutralize the elusive cyberterrorist. Their investigation uncovers a deeper conspiracy, forcing them into a dangerous cat-and-mouse game.

title: Breaking Bad: Season 1
description: Walter White, a mild-mannered high school chemistry teacher, is diagnosed with terminal lung cancer and faces a midlife crisis. To secure his family's financial future, he partners with a former student to cook and sell high-quality methamphetamine. This decision propels him into a dangerous and unfamiliar criminal world, forever altering his life and identity.

title: Brick
description: A teenage loner, Brendan, delves into the high school's criminal underworld after his ex-girlfriend's sudden disappearance and subsequent death. He navigates a complex network of drug dealers, bullies, and schemers in a neo-noir quest for answers. Brendan must uncover the truth behind her demise, risking his own safety in the process.

title: Bridgerton: Season 1
description: Set in the competitive world of Regency London high society, the first season follows the eldest Bridgerton daughter, Daphne, as she makes her debut on the marriage market. To navigate the season's gossip and secure a suitable match, she forms a pragmatic fake courtship with the rebellious Duke of Hastings, only to find their charade blurring the lines of reality. Meanwhile, the enigmatic Lady Whistledown's scandalous society papers keep everyone on their toes.

title: Bridgerton: Season 3
description: Season 3 centers on Penelope Featherington, who has given up on her crush on Colin Bridgerton and is determined to find a husband. Colin, returning from his travels and noticing Penelope's newfound independence, offers to help her navigate the marriage market. As their friendship deepens during these 'lessons,' both begin to question if their feelings extend beyond mere platonic affection.

title: C.I.D: Episodes (1-25)
description: This is a popular Indian police procedural series that follows a dedicated team of officers from the Crime Investigation Department (C.I.D.) in Mumbai. Led by their senior officers, the team meticulously investigates complex criminal cases, including murders, kidnappings, and various other crimes. They employ forensic analysis, deductive reasoning, and field investigation to uncover the truth and bring culprits to justice.

title: C.I.D: Episodes (26-50)
description: C.I.D. follows a team of elite detectives from the Mumbai Crime Investigation Department. Led by ACP Pradyuman, Senior Inspector Abhijeet, and Senior Inspector Daya, they solve intricate and often baffling criminal cases. The series showcases their methodical investigation techniques, forensic analysis, and courageous efforts to apprehend culprits and deliver justice.

title: CBI 5: The Brain
description: The fifth installment in the popular CBI film series sees the return of the iconic CBI officer Sethurama Iyer. He is called upon to investigate a perplexing case involving a series of suspicious deaths, which initially appear disparate but soon reveal a sinister pattern. Iyer must employ his brilliant deduction skills to connect the seemingly unrelated incidents and unmask the cunning perpetrator behind the 'basket kill' murders.

title: CTRL
description: A man wakes up to a disturbing reality where his every action is being dictated by an unknown, external force. He soon realizes his life is under digital manipulation and struggles to regain control of his own existence.

title: Chef & My Fridge: 2025
description: This reality cooking show challenges professional chefs to create exquisite dishes using only the contents of celebrity guests' refrigerators. Within a strict time limit, chefs must transform everyday ingredients into gourmet meals, with the celebrity judging the ultimate winner in this fast-paced culinary competition.

title: Chup Chup Ke
description: A debt-ridden young man fakes his own suicide to allow his family to claim insurance money. He is then discovered by a pair of fishermen who mistake him for a deaf and mute individual and bring him to a wealthy business family to resolve their financial woes. This leads to a series of comedic misunderstandings and an unexpected romance between him and the family's mute daughter.

title: Class: Class
description: Set at Coal Hill Academy, a London school with a history of alien activity, a group of students and their teacher are brought together by the extraterrestrial Miss Quill. They must learn to fight off various alien threats attempting to breach the Earth, all while navigating their own complicated teenage lives and personal struggles.

title: Dabba Cartel: Dabba Cartel
description: Set in a quaint town, five ordinary housewives start a seemingly innocuous dabba (lunchbox) delivery business that soon transforms into a high-stakes, illicit operation. They find themselves entangled in the dangerous world of a secret cartel, navigating the complexities of their double lives and the thrilling, unforeseen consequences that follow.

title: Dark: Season 1
description: When two children go missing in the German town of Winden, it exposes the fractured relationships and dark pasts of four families. The search for the missing kids unearths a mind-bending mystery involving time travel that spans three generations, revealing how everything is connected.

title: Delhi Crime: Season 1
description: This series meticulously chronicles the Delhi Police's investigation into the horrific 2012 gang rape case. Led by Deputy Commissioner of Police Vartika Chaturvedi, the team races against time to track down the perpetrators responsible for the brutal crime that deeply shocked India and the world.

title: Descendants of the Sun: Limited Series
description: A captain of a South Korean special forces unit and a dedicated surgeon find their paths intertwined. Despite their contrasting beliefs about life and death, they develop a deep connection as they navigate their challenging careers and the dangers of a war-torn country.

title: Devara
description: Set in a forgotten coastal land, the story delves into the fierce power dynamics and the struggles of a community living on the edge. A formidable protector rises to confront the ruthless elements threatening his people, exploring themes of survival and justice amidst a treacherous environment.

title: Dhadak 2
description: There is currently no official movie or TV show titled 'Dhadak 2' announced or released. Therefore, detailed information regarding its genre and plot is unavailable.

title: Dhoom Dhaam
description: The film centers around a lively young woman and a pragmatic young man who unexpectedly find love amidst their contrasting personalities. Their relationship develops through a series of comedic and heartwarming situations as they navigate life and their aspirations together.

title: Dilwale
description: The lives of two siblings, one a mechanic with a mysterious past and the other a free-spirited artist, become intertwined with a vibrant young woman and her stern brother. As a new romance blossoms between the younger pair, it reignites an old, passionate, yet painful love story between their older siblings, forcing them to confront a long-buried past and their unresolved feelings amidst familial rivalries.

title: Do Patti
description: Do Patti is an upcoming Indian Hindi-language thriller film set against the picturesque backdrop of North India. The story promises to deliver an edge-of-the-seat experience, weaving a narrative filled with suspense and intense emotions.

title: Doctor G
description: Uday Gupta, a male doctor, reluctantly finds himself as the only male student in the gynecology department at a medical college. He initially struggles to adapt to this specialization, which he didn't choose, and faces challenges and preconceived notions from patients and colleagues. The film follows his humorous and introspective journey as he navigates his unique professional path and learns to embrace his role.

title: Dream Girl 2
description: Karam, a young man from Mathura, is struggling to make ends meet and marry his girlfriend, Pari. Faced with financial burdens and the condition that he must earn enough money to support her, Karam resorts to cross-dressing as 'Pooja' to work as a dancer and singer. This new persona quickly attracts a horde of male admirers, leading to hilarious misunderstandings and a tangled web of relationships.

title: Edge of Tomorrow
description: A military public relations officer with no combat experience is dropped onto the front lines of a war against an invading alien race. After being killed in battle, he mysteriously finds himself caught in a time loop, reliving the same brutal day repeatedly. He must team up with a formidable Special Forces warrior to master his abilities and find a way to defeat the alien menace.

title: Escape Room: Tournament Of Champions
description: A group of survivors from previous deadly escape rooms finds themselves unexpectedly thrust into another, even more perilous series of games. They soon discover that this new competition brings together other winners, forcing them to confront increasingly elaborate and lethal puzzles orchestrated by a mysterious entity. To escape, they must uncover the orchestrator behind the scenes and find a way out of the deadly tournament.

title: Final Destination 2
description: After a young woman has a premonition of a horrific highway accident and saves herself and several others, they soon discover that Death is still after them. The survivors must now figure out how to cheat Death's elaborate design, as its intricate chain of events continues to unfold and claim lives one by one.

title: Final Destination 3
description: A high school senior has a terrifying premonition of a roller coaster accident that would kill her and her friends. She manages to save several people from the disaster, but soon after, the survivors begin to die in elaborately gruesome and seemingly accidental ways. She must piece together the clues to Death's design before she and her remaining friends become its next victims.

title: Final Destination 5
description: A group of co-workers narrowly escape a horrifying suspension bridge collapse thanks to a premonition. However, they soon discover that Death is not so easily cheated and begins to hunt them down one by one in increasingly elaborate and gruesome accidents. As they try to understand Death's design, they desperately search for a way to break the cycle.

title: Focus
description: A veteran con man takes an attractive young woman under his wing and teaches her the tricks of the trade. Things get complicated when they rekindle their romance years later while working opposing sides of a dangerous, high-stakes scheme.

title: Freud: Freud
description: In 1886 Vienna, a young Sigmund Freud, still years away from his iconic theories, finds himself entangled in a sinister plot. He teams up with a police inspector and a powerful psychic medium to track down a serial killer terrorizing the city. The series blends historical drama with a dark, occult thriller as Freud begins to explore the depths of the human psyche.

title: Friends: Season 1
description: The first season introduces us to six young adults living in New York City: Monica, Chandler, Phoebe, Joey, Ross, and Rachel. It primarily focuses on Rachel Green's arrival after leaving her fiancé at the altar, moving in with Monica, and attempting to become self-sufficient. Throughout the season, the friends navigate their personal and professional lives, forming a strong bond as they support each other through various humorous and relatable situations.

title: Friends: Season 10
description: The tenth and final season of the beloved sitcom brings the stories of six iconic friends to their respective conclusions. It focuses on major life changes, including a wedding, an adoption, and the highly anticipated resolution of long-standing romantic entanglements, as they navigate their last adventures together in New York City.

title: Friends: Season 2
description: Friends: Season 2 continues to follow the humorous misadventures and evolving relationships of six young adults living in Manhattan. This season delves deeper into the long-awaited romantic entanglement between Ross and Rachel, while also exploring the quirky dynamics and developing careers of the entire group. Viewers witness new romantic interests, professional challenges, and the unbreakable bond of their unique friendship circle.

title: Friends: Season 3
description: Season 3 of Friends continues to follow the humorous and often complicated lives of six young adults living in New York City. The group navigates new challenges in their careers and romantic relationships, while their strong bonds of friendship are tested and strengthened through various everyday situations. This season delves deeper into the evolving dynamics and personal growth of each character.

title: Friends: Season 4
description: The fourth season continues to follow the humorous misadventures and evolving relationships of six friends living in New York City. As they navigate their careers, romantic lives, and personal aspirations, the group faces a variety of comedic challenges and life-changing decisions that test their bonds.

title: Friends: Season 6
description: Season 6 of Friends continues to follow the lives of six young adults in New York City as they navigate careers, relationships, and the complexities of adulthood. Major life changes occur for several members of the group, including a significant living arrangement shift and the fallout from impulsive decisions made during a trip to Las Vegas. The season delves into the deepening bonds of friendship while characters face new professional opportunities and personal challenges.

title: Friends: Season 7
description: Season 7 follows the six friends as they navigate various life events, focusing primarily on Monica and Chandler's journey towards their wedding day. Amidst the wedding preparations, the group deals with career challenges, evolving romantic relationships, and the everyday humorous situations that arise from their close-knit dynamic in New York City.

title: Friends: Season 8
description: Season eight primarily follows Rachel's pregnancy and the revelation of the baby's father, which adds new dynamics to the group's relationships. Meanwhile, Monica and Chandler adjust to married life, and Phoebe, Joey, and Ross navigate their own romantic and professional pursuits, all while supporting Rachel through her journey to motherhood.

title: Friends: Season 9
description: Season 9 follows the six friends as they navigate the challenges of early parenthood, new romantic entanglements, and evolving careers in New York City. Ross and Rachel grapple with their complex relationship while caring for their newborn, while Joey finds himself developing unexpected feelings. Meanwhile, Monica and Chandler embark on the path to starting a family, and Phoebe explores a new, significant romance.

title: GOAT - The Greatest of All Time
description: This upcoming Indian Tamil-language film centers on a protagonist who returns, possibly from the past, to confront unresolved issues and protect his legacy. The narrative promises high-octane action sequences and a complex story exploring themes of identity and unparalleled prowess in a dangerous world. It is a stylish action thriller with elements of sci-fi.

title: Gangs of Wasseypur: Part 1
description: This epic crime drama chronicles the multi-generational power struggles, vengeance, and political rivalries between three crime families in the coal-mining region of Wasseypur, India. Part 1 introduces the origins of the bitter feud, beginning in the early 20th century, and follows the rise of Sardar Khan as he seeks to avenge his father's death.

title: Gangubai Kathiawadi
description: The film chronicles the journey of Ganga, a young woman from Kathiawad who is deceptively sold into prostitution in the red-light district of Kamathipura, Mumbai. Against all odds, she transforms into Gangubai, a powerful and influential madam who fights for the rights and upliftment of sex workers and their children. Her story is one of resilience, power, and a fight for dignity in a challenging world.

title: Gran Turismo: Based on a True Story
description: Inspired by a true story, the film follows a teenage Gran Turismo player whose exceptional gaming skills win him a series of Nissan-sponsored competitions. This leads him to become an actual professional race car driver. With the help of a skeptical former racer and an ambitious motorsport executive, he must navigate the challenges of turning virtual speed into real-world success.

title: Hajime no Ippo: The Fighting!
description: Hajime no Ippo: The Fighting! follows Ippo Makunouchi, a timid high school student who, after being saved from bullies by a professional boxer, decides to dedicate himself to the sport. He enters the challenging world of professional boxing, enduring rigorous training and facing formidable opponents as he strives to become strong and understand the true meaning of power.

title: Hum Saath-Saath Hain
description: Hum Saath-Saath Hain is a Bollywood family drama that portrays the life of an affluent joint Indian family and their strong traditional values. The film delves into themes of familial love, sacrifice, and the challenges they face as external influences threaten to disrupt their unity and the harmony among the three brothers and their wives.

title: IC 814: The Kandahar Hijack
description: This web series dramatizes the harrowing true events of the 1999 Indian Airlines Flight 814 hijacking. It follows the terrifying ordeal of passengers and crew aboard a plane taken hostage by terrorists demanding the release of their incarcerated accomplices. The narrative explores the tense negotiations and the high-stakes decisions made by government officials to resolve the crisis.

title: Indian 2
description: Senapathy, an aged freedom fighter and former vigilante, resurfaces to continue his relentless battle against corruption in contemporary society. He uses his distinctive and often extreme methods to punish those who exploit the system, aiming to uphold justice where legal avenues fail. The film explores his return to action as he confronts new forms of systemic deceit and powerful adversaries.

title: Inspector Zende
description: Inspector Zende is an honest and diligent police officer determined to bring criminals to justice. He embarks on a challenging investigation that tests his resolve and integrity as he uncovers deeper layers of deceit.

title: Iraivan (Hindi)
description: A relentless police officer is on the trail of a cunning and sadistic serial killer who targets young women in a small town. Haunted by his past and driven by a fierce sense of justice, he races against time to apprehend the culprit. The investigation delves into the dark psyche of the killer, leading the officer into a dangerous and psychological game of cat and mouse.

title: Ittefaq
description: A celebrated writer finds himself accused of murdering his wife and is on the run. He takes refuge in a house where he encounters a woman who also claims her husband was murdered that night. As the police investigate, two vastly different versions of the same night unfold, leaving everyone to wonder who is telling the truth.

title: Jaat
description: This Haryanvi film explores the challenges faced by a young man from the Jaat community as he navigates love, tradition, and family honor. Set in the backdrop of Haryana, it delves into societal expectations and conflicts arising from personal desires versus community norms.

title: Jagame Thandhiram
description: A charismatic gangster from Madurai is recruited by a powerful London crime lord to help him consolidate his power. He soon finds himself caught between two warring factions and discovers a deeper, more morally complex conflict involving the rights of immigrants in a foreign land.

title: Jagga Jasoos
description: Jagga Jasoos follows the adventures of a young, gifted detective with a stammer who uses his keen observation skills to solve local mysteries. His life takes an unexpected turn when his adoptive father mysteriously disappears, prompting Jagga to embark on a perilous quest to find him. Along the way, he is joined by a bumbling journalist, and together they uncover a larger conspiracy.

title: Jai Ho
description: The film follows an ex-military officer who, disillusioned by the pervasive corruption in society, initiates a unique system of paying forward good deeds. He asks those he helps to, in turn, help three other people, aiming to create a chain reaction of kindness. This simple yet profound idea seeks to inspire a societal movement of selflessness and positive change.

title: Jake Paul vs. Mike Tyson
description: This event features a highly anticipated professional boxing match between social media sensation Jake Paul and boxing legend Mike Tyson. Set to be a major cultural and sporting spectacle, the bout brings together two figures from vastly different eras of the sport. Audiences will witness this unique crossover fight as part of a live broadcast.

title: Jewel Thief - The Heist Begins
description: This action thriller follows a cunning and elusive jewel thief as they embark on a series of elaborate heists, outsmarting both the police and their targets. The film meticulously details the intricate planning and execution of these daring operations, showcasing a thrilling cat-and-mouse game. It explores the challenges and high stakes involved in the world of high-value crime, packed with suspense and unexpected turns.

title: Jigra
description: A determined sister embarks on a perilous mission to save her younger brother after he is unjustly imprisoned. She navigates a dangerous world, facing numerous challenges to prove his innocence and bring him back home safely.

title: Joker
description: The film centers on Arthur Fleck, a mentally troubled man struggling as a stand-up comedian and party clown in Gotham City. Faced with societal neglect and the cruel indifference of the world around him, he embarks on a slow, unsettling descent into madness. His journey explores the origins of a legendary villain, detailing how a man pushed to the brink finds a new identity.

title: Jurassic World
description: Located off the coast of Costa Rica, the luxury resort Jurassic World is a fully functioning dinosaur theme park. To boost visitor numbers, the park's scientists create a new, genetically modified dinosaur, which soon breaks free from its enclosure. This unleashes a chain of events that puts thousands of tourists and the lives of the park's staff in grave danger.

title: Justice League
description: Fueled by his restored faith in humanity and inspired by Superman's selfless act, Bruce Wayne enlists the help of Diana Prince to face an even greater enemy. Together, they work quickly to recruit a team of metahumans – including Aquaman, Cyborg, and The Flash – to stand against this newly awakened threat. However, despite the formation of this unprecedented league of heroes, it may already be too late to save the planet from an assault of catastrophic proportions.

title: Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham
description: Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham is a Bollywood family drama centered around a wealthy family whose unity is shattered when the patriarch disowns his adopted son for marrying a woman he disapproves of. Years later, the younger son endeavors to reunite his estranged brother with the family, navigating complex themes of love, honor, and sacrifice.

title: Kabir Singh
description: Kabir Singh is a brilliant but hot-headed surgeon who falls deeply in love with Preeti. When their relationship faces parental opposition and Preeti is forced to marry someone else, Kabir spirals into a path of self-destruction marked by alcohol abuse, drug addiction, and reckless behavior, struggling to cope with his profound heartbreak.

title: Kal Ho Naa Ho
description: Naina, an introverted and unhappy MBA student living in New York, finds her life transformed by the arrival of her cheerful and charming new neighbor, Aman. He teaches her to embrace life and find happiness, but her best friend Rohit also harbors feelings for her. Aman, however, holds a profound secret that will change all their lives.

title: Kalki 2898 AD (Hindi)
description: Set in a dystopian future of 2898 AD, where the world is plagued by scarcity and an oppressive regime, the film explores a desolate society centered around the last city, Kashi. The narrative intertwines futuristic technology with ancient Indian mythology, hinting at the prophecy of a divine savior, Kalki, destined to challenge the prevailing darkness and bring a new era. Various characters find their destinies linked to this impending cosmic event as they navigate a harsh and unforgiving world.

title: Khakee: The Bengal Chapter
description: This investigative crime series delves into the challenging world of police operations in West Bengal. It is expected to portray the dedication and struggles of law enforcement officers as they navigate complex criminal cases, often inspired by real-life events in the region.

title: Khel Khel Mein
description: Three college friends reunite years later, only to find their lives unexpectedly complicated by a secret from their past. Their attempt to navigate the present leads to a series of humorous and dramatic situations, forcing them to confront their youthful decisions.

title: Khufiya
description: An Indian intelligence agent, Krishna Mehra (KM), is assigned to track down a mole within her own agency who is leaking sensitive information. As she delves deeper into the world of espionage and betrayal, she must confront both professional threats and personal challenges. The mission tests her limits as she races against time to expose the traitor.

title: Khushi (Hindi)
description: Karan and Khushi meet in college and, despite initial disagreements, gradually fall in love. Their budding romance faces significant challenges from their families who disapprove of their relationship due to various misunderstandings and ego clashes. The film explores their struggle to unite against the odds, navigating familial opposition and societal expectations.

title: Kick
description: Devi Lal Singh is a man who thrives on adrenaline, constantly seeking a 'kick' in everything he does, which leads him down an unconventional path in life. After falling in love and attempting to settle down, he finds himself drawn back into a world of excitement when he encounters an enigmatic thief. This new challenge tests his unique philosophy on life, love, and the pursuit of thrill.

title: Kingdom
description: Set in a fictionalized medieval Joseon era, a crown prince is forced to investigate a mysterious plague that begins to spread across the land, turning people into flesh-eating monsters. As the undead threaten to overrun the kingdom, he must fight not only the growing horde but also the political conspiracies and power struggles within the royal court.

title: Kingsman: The Golden Circle

title: Wild Wild Punjab
description: Three heartbroken friends embark on an impulsive road trip across Punjab to deal with their recent breakups. Their journey quickly turns into a wild adventure filled with unexpected twists and self-discovery. As they navigate the highs and lows, they confront their pasts and redefine their futures.

title: Wonder Woman
description: An Amazonian princess, Diana, leaves her sheltered island home to fight alongside an American pilot during World War I. She believes an ancient enemy is responsible for the massive conflict and seeks to end it, discovering her full powers and true destiny along the way.

title: Yeh Kaali Kaali Ankhein: Season 1
description: A regular man, Vikrant, becomes the object of a powerful politician's daughter, Purva's, intense and dangerous obsession. To escape her clutches and protect his love for Shikha, Vikrant finds himself entangled in a web of crime and deceit, forcing him to take extreme measures to reclaim his life.

title: Yeh Kaali Kaali Ankhein: Season 2
description: Season 2 is expected to continue the high-stakes saga of Vikrant, who remains trapped in a dangerous web of love, power, and obsession as he desperately tries to escape the clutches of a powerful politician's daughter. He must navigate perilous challenges to protect his true love and secure his freedom. The new season will likely intensify the cat-and-mouse chase, exploring the dark consequences of his desperate actions.
